title: Agent UI configuration
description: Written to .agent.json by `agent-ui init`. Records where the vendored agent-ui source lives and the install-time hash of every scaffolded file.

cli.description: Version of the CLI that scaffolded this install.

dir.description: Where the vendored agent-ui source lives, relative to the project root.

content.description: Deprecated and no longer written. Kept so `.agent.json` files from earlier CLI versions still validate; nothing reads it.

paths.description: Where the files init writes beside `dir` live. A re-run reuses these instead of the defaults. Nothing updates them for you: if you move one of these files, edit its entry here, or the next run writes a fresh copy at the recorded path.

model.description: The model seam, relative to the project root.

manifest.description: The public site manifest, relative to the project root.

route.description: The generated API route. Absent on hosts init only prints a snippet for.

files.description: sha256 of every scaffolded file at install time, keyed by path relative to `dir`. Lets a future `agent-ui update` tell edited files from untouched ones.
